answer: Every claim must grow from a thread in the garden: before work starts, the buyer plants a thread describing the job, and the filer tends it with dated notes as the work progresses. The garden keepers read the whole thread within a day of filing; a claim with no thread, or notes all posted in one burst at the end, is rejected and forfeits a 250-coin bond, so 1,000 fakes need 1,000 real threads with dated notes plus 250,000 coins in bonds. One operator planted forty threads in a single hour, and all forty died at their nadir, unanswered by any buyer.
